facts.function: reclining mechanism enabling the back and footrest of a recliner seat to move
facts.form: mechanism assemblies (possibly unassembled), made to the specifications of the recliner
facts.end_use: incorporation into household reclining chairs and sofas

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9401 covers seats and parts thereof; the mechanism is identifiable as a part of recliner seats
Chapter 94 note 1 and Section XV note 2 checked: a recliner mechanism is a dedicated seat part, not a part of general use (screws, springs, hinges)
GRI 6: 9401.99 parts other than of wood; 9401.99.90 other (not motor vehicle, cane, or rubber/plastics); suffix .85 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of wood; the mechanism is metal
limited to parts of motor vehicle seats; recliner mechanisms are for household furniture
base metal furniture mountings/fittings; the recliner mechanism is a dedicated functional seat part, as CBP held in N012776
covers sofa bed seat deck components, not recliner mechanisms

missing_facts: Whether the mechanisms are for motor vehicle seats (would move to 9401.99.10)
classification.rationale: A metal recliner mechanism is made to fit and operate recliner seats, so heading 9401 covers it as a part of seats. It is not a part of general use of base metal. Because it is not wood, it falls in 9401.99 and in 9401.99.90.85 as other parts. NY N012776 (in force) classified a metal recliner mechanism as a seat part in 9401.90.5080, the predecessor line of today's 9401.99.90.
